All plugins on this page require Citizens and Spout.

==Custom Skins==
There are several extension plugins that allow the changing of Citizen/Spout NPC skins. For more info on Citizens Skins see [[Skins]]

*[[http://dev.bukkit.org/server-mods/simpleskins-reloaded/ SimpleSkins Reloaded]] by DreTax (CURRENT!)
*[[http://forums.spout.org/threads/fun-misc-rpg-skinthecitizens2-customize-your-citizen2-npcs-sp-1298-cb-1-3-1-r2-1.4148/ SkinTheCitizens2]]  by tenowg (May be outdated)
*[[http://dev.bukkit.org/server-mods/citizenskins/ CitizensSkins]] by LargoUsagi (May be outdated)
*[[http://forums.bukkit.org/threads/citiskins-skin-citizen-npcs.61273/ CitiSkins]] by WindWaker (not released?)

==Denizen Commands==
This extension plugin adds several Spout commands to Denizen
*[[http://forums.spout.org/threads/npc-fun-extenddenizens-spn1298-cb1-3-1-r2-1.4795/ ExtendDenizens]] by Tenowg
